description.value: On the Run is a 24-hour convenience store chain location in Richmond, BC, situated along Number 3 Road. It offers convenience store goods, a restaurant, and washrooms, making it a practical stop for cyclists needing supplies at any hour. The brand also supports EV charging at select locations, suggesting some infrastructure for modern mobility.
